youtube.title: Bubble Wrap Kis Kaam Ke Liye Bana Tha? 🫧 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Bubble wrap asal mein aapki deewaron ke liye banaya gaya tha. 1957 mein New Jersey ke do engineers ne do shower curtains ko jodkar andar hawa ke bubbles fasa diye. Plan tha ek textured, washable, futuristic wallpaper ka.

Lekin kisi ko wallpaper chahiye hi nahi tha. Greenhouse insulation ke roop mein bechne ki koshish bhi fail hui. Phir IBM aayi, jise apne bilkul naye, nazuk computers bhejne ka tareeka chahiye tha. Bubble wrap perfect nikla, aur achanak yeh har jagah pahunch gaya.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
